Date: 23 August 2026

To

Dr. Md. Mainul Hossain  
Professor & Chair  
Department of Biochemistry & Biotechnology  
North South University

Subject: Request for Permission to Display cBLAST Course Poster on the Department Notice Board

Respected Sir/Madam,

We write to you on behalf of cBLAST (Center for Bioinformatics Learning, Advancement and Systematics Training) under the Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, University of Dhaka. cBLAST offers modular, self-paced online courses in bioinformatics covering databases, sequence analysis, statistics, programming (R, Python, UNIX/Linux), proteomics, cheminformatics, next-generation sequencing data analysis, and machine learning for biologists. Each course carries a certificate equivalent to a 2-credit University of Dhaka course, verifiable online by a unique ID and QR code.

As you must be aware, knowledge of bioinformatics for the life sciences has shown critical significance, particularly in the early undergraduate years. Therefore, we are giving a needed push to promote this resource among all students of bioinformatics and computer science in Bangladesh.

Our next course session begins on 15 September 2026 and runs for three months, delivered fully online through pre-recorded video lectures with graded quizzes and assignments. Registration closes on 15 September 2026, and students who enroll before this date receive a 20% early-enrollment discount; teams of five enrolling together receive 50% off. We would be grateful for your permission to display the enclosed course poster on the notice board so that students in relevant disciplines, e.g., Biochemistry, Biotechnology, and related life sciences, may learn about this opportunity.  
A soft copy of the course poster is enclosed for your approval for posting. Once approved, we will send hard copies of the posters ASAP. We would also welcome any guidance on your department's process for notice board postings.

Thank you for your time and continued support of student learning. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you require any further information.  
Sincerely,
